mentions.name: Spicy Circuits
mentions.description: Spicy Circuits is a make-your-own-circuit simulator taught through an online course in Python. Learners go through hosted lessons to learn electronics without the math, and by the end they have built their own working circuit simulator.
mentions.problem: Learning electronics is typically hindered by the required mathematics.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I created a make-your-own-circuit simulator in python to help learn electronics. The best part about this is that it is entirely hosted online and people can just go through the lessons, learn electronics by skipping the maths, and in the process have made their own circuit simulator (which is arguably a pretty cool project on its own) at the end of it.

https://spicycircuits.dev/
mentions.author: pkoird
